goal: Produce a short organic plan for Facebook Page and Facebook Reels using the same analytics-backed pipeline as Instagram (Meta signals). Map Prepare output to Feed vs Reels vs Stories in milestone Data.

milestones.title: Facebook campaign brief
milestones.goal: Lock dates, Page objective, and Facebook surfaces before generated content.
milestones.data:
## Facebook campaign brief

**Start date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**End date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**Page objective:** <!-- e.g. Drive reservations from Page followers -->
**Primary offer or theme:** <!-- e.g. weekday lunch set menu -->
**Facebook surfaces to use:** <!-- e.g. Page Feed, Facebook Reels, Stories -->
**Key menu items to feature:** <!-- comma-separated -->
**Target audience on Facebook:** <!-- e.g. local 5 mi, 25–45, food explorers -->
**Primary Page CTA:** <!-- e.g. Book now, Call, Message, Get directions -->
**Post cadence:** <!-- e.g. 4 Feed + 2 Reels per week -->
**Events or holidays in window:** <!-- dates or "none" -->
**Notes:** <!-- Groups cross-post, paid boost later, etc. -->

passCriteria.requirement: Start date is specified (YYYY-MM-DD or clear equivalent).
End date is specified and is on or after the start date.
At least one Facebook surface is named (Feed, Reels, Stories, or Event).
At least one key menu item or offer to feature is listed.

milestones.title: Brand Brief
milestones.goal: Define pillars and tone from POS data; reuse for Facebook Page copy and Reels scripts.

passCriteria.requirement: Content pillars are defined (typically 3–5) and tied to menu or operating signals.
Tone guardrails are documented (bullet list or short section).
Audience hypotheses are grounded in operating data (peaks, meal periods), not invented demographics.

milestones.title: Organic post schedule
milestones.goal: Run Prepare to generate a schedule from Instagram/Meta engagement signals; in Data, relabel slots for Facebook (Feed / Facebook Reels / Stories) and keep dish-level picks.

passCriteria.requirement: Schedule covers the full campaign window from the Facebook campaign brief.
Each planned slot names at least one featured menu item.
Each slot names an intended Facebook surface or format (Feed post, Facebook Reel, Story, or similar).
Suggested times reference analytics signals (e.g. bestPostingWindow) where present, as timing hints for local audience.
